Cristiano Ronaldo is a Portuguese professional footballer (born 5 February 1985) widely regarded as one of the greatest players of all time. A prolific forward, he has played for Sporting CP, Manchester United (two spells), Real Madrid, Juventus, and, since 2023, Al Nassr in Saudi Arabia. He also represents Portugal.

Highlights:
- All-time leading men’s international goalscorer and the most-capped men’s international player for Portugal; won Euro 2016 and the 2019 UEFA Nations League.
- Five Ballon d’Or awards and five UEFA Champions League titles.
- League titles in England, Spain, and Italy; Real Madrid’s all-time top scorer and the Champions League’s record goalscorer.
- Known for exceptional athleticism, goal-scoring, longevity, and the CR7 brand.

Brawl Stars is a free-to-play mobile hero shooter by Supercell (iOS and Android). It features fast, short matches in 3v3 team modes and a solo/duo battle-royale mode (Showdown). Players choose from “Brawlers,” each with unique attacks and a powerful Super, plus optional Gadgets and Star Powers.

Key points:
- Game modes: Gem Grab, Brawl Ball, Heist, Hot Zone, Bounty, Knockout, and Solo/Duo Showdown.
- Progression: earn trophies, unlock Brawlers, and collect upgrades; seasonal Brawl Pass and cosmetic skins.
- Social/competitive: clubs, ranked play, and an official esports scene (Brawl Stars Championship).
Yes—Brawl Stars is a free-to-play mobile game by Supercell, available on iOS and Android.
